modeDecision.reason: Usage explicitly contains Work/Codex shared credits and Codex resets. Personal billing uses account/session guards and a chatGpt access family, while payments/pricing have shared consumers. Teams role/route predicates do not establish product mode. No full-family exclusion is justified.

keepFirstParty: mandate fresh-consent comparison and redirect cleanup
dependencyBoundary.versionAuthority: Existing dependency-import and embedded-dependency inventories; no new version inferred from aliases.

moduleDecisions.decision: Separate usage overview/history, shared credits/auto-reload orchestration and Codex reset preference/redemption. Keep delegated panels explicit; use external chart/query packages and shared financial adapters.

Separate personal account entitlement/session presentation from shared billing/payment/mandate adapters and provider forms. Keep fresh-consent and deletion safety policy in first-party source; defer live financial verification locally.

Separate team navigation/presentation, membership/update/ownership policy and activity search from account-scoped service adapters and shared lifecycle/resource dialogs. Preserve last-member deletion as a distinct confirmed consequence.

notSeparateFeatures: each pagination cursor or historical row
lazy dialog internals beyond their reviewed handoff
service-account tab editor absent in the compiled body
